caption: The drawing depicts a colored statue of a standing male figure with a beard and mustache, and long, dark hair partially covered by a cloth or hood in a tan color. The figure is mostly nude, with only a yellowish loincloth-like cloth draped around the waist, and a reddish-brown cloak hanging from the shoulders. The left leg is slightly bent at the knee, and the left foot points forward while the right foot is behind, both standing on a dark green base. The right arm is crossed over the chest, with the hand resting on the shoulder, while the left hand covers the genital area. The figure has visible lines and shading, indicating the folds of the cloth and the form of the body. The statue is set against a plain, light-colored background within a bordered rectangular frame. The artist's name, MINA LOWRY, appears in the lower right corner.
title: Figurehead: Hercules
